coordinate_trust.sign_convention: trust band normals use +/- coordinate directions with nonnegative multipliers

offdiag_box.sign_convention: lower normal is -E_ij, upper normal is +E_ij with nonnegative multipliers

structural_band.sign_convention: structural residual band normals use +/- residual directions with nonnegative multipliers

duality_gap.note: No dual objective pass is claimed; stationarity plus valid normal decomposition is the acceptance path.

class_trust.sign_convention: Lorentz dual for class mean trust balls
